blocks.text: A group of respiratory disorders characterized by chronic infection and pus formation in the airways and/or lung parenchyma, leading to persistent inflammation, tissue destruction, and structural abnormalities.

blocks.text: Common Types: Bronchiectasis, Lung abscess, Empyema, Necrotizing Pneumonia
A chronic lung condition characterized by permanent, abnormal dilation of the bronchi due to chronic infection, inflammation, and/or impaired mucociliary clearance.

A lung abscess is a localized collection of pus in the lung parenchyma caused by suppurative necrosis of lung tissue, resulting in cavity formation, usually with an air-fluid level.
